observational_anchor.observation: The reported single-operation RandAugment ablation includes Invert harming SmallNORB. This is a published training experiment, not a new local observation; its exact training configuration has not been reproduced here.

question_screened: Could a shared normalization state for clean and polarity-inverted training images, rather than destruction of object category, account for this reported harm?

closest_primary_prior.title: Does Data Augmentation Benefit from Split BatchNorms
closest_primary_prior.authors: Amil Merchant, Barret Zoph, Ekin Dogus Cubuk
closest_primary_prior.read_scope: official arXiv abstract and submission metadata; full implementation or SmallNORB-specific result not read
closest_primary_prior.covered_mechanism: Strong augmentation induces train/evaluation disparity; auxiliary normalization and choice of clean/weak augmentation statistics at evaluation are directly examined. Thus generic normalization mismatch or split normalization is an existing research mechanism, not a new contribution.

decision: Do not train merely to re-demonstrate the known normalization principle on a new toy dataset. No new augmentation-specific differentiating prediction has been established.
exact_coverage_limit: The read prior does not establish the actual cause of the reported Invert/SmallNORB loss, nor prove an exactly equivalent SmallNORB study exists. Lack of an exact dataset match is not alone a substantive increment.
falsification_controls_if_a_substantive_: First reproduce a prespecified training-value contrast on untouched physical objects; a frozen classifier reaction is insufficient.
Prespecify same source images, updates, initialization pairing and augmentation assignment; separately vary normalization-state policy and report all arms on one fixed clean target.
Any evaluation-statistics recalibration must use training-side images only and remain separate from full training-policy effects.
A normalization intervention also changes optimization; recovery is not unique causal mediation evidence unless other explanations are distinguished.
kill_conditions: If no training-value harm is reproducible under a fixed valid protocol, do not pursue an explanation of that absent local phenomenon.
If the increment is only clean/strong augmentation normalization mismatch, mark replication of existing mechanism.
Do not tune inversion probability, BN mode, model or test subset until an appealing outcome appears.
reviewer: root focused primary-source screen, not an additional independent reviewer
